meta.name: Stranded with My Mother-in-Law
meta.description: To win a life-changing prize, couples embark on a journey to an earthly paradise and confront challenges... with the assistance of their mothers-in-law.

videos.title: Desert Island Companion
videos.overview: Six couples travel to a mysterious beach to confront challenges and compete for a grand prize, unaware that their mothers-in-law are also present.

videos.title: Airing the Dirty Laundry
videos.overview: Severina and Thy open up. A family therapist meets the competitors. Two participants have a heated argument over who owns an apartment.

videos.title: Mother-in-Law's Tongue
videos.overview: Taninha becomes suspicious of Thy and Severina. The bunker team discovers the emergency button. Two contestants contemplate leaving the experiment.

videos.title: SOS – Every Man for Himself
videos.overview: The emergency button is pressed. Thy opens up about his strategy, but the results don't go as planned. Unexpected guests visit the village.

videos.title: Coming Home
videos.overview: A new challenge shifts family dynamics forever. Shenia has a highly emotional chat with the in-laws, while the bunker team gets thrilling news.

videos.title: Queen of the Memes
videos.overview: The in-laws have fun talking about their love lives. Someone presses the emergency button. Felipe and Severina bond — but not everyone approves.

videos.title: Deal With It!
videos.overview: The Tenórios strategize after the emergency button is pressed. Felipe becomes disappointed with his team, and a secret about the grand prize is revealed.

videos.title: Mothers-in-Law's Secret
videos.overview: One of the families secures their spot in the final challenge. Before the end, in-laws must make a dramatic decision about the big prize.

videos.title: Caught Between my Mother-in-Law and The Deep Blue Sea
videos.overview: Fernanda Souza introduces the six families featured this season. Early alliances form, and an initial conflict between in-laws heats up.

videos.title: Swimming Against The Tide
videos.overview: Heated arguments and misalignments spark conflicts on the island, disrupting the tranquility of the bunker. Shenia Karlsson leads a group session.

videos.title: Full Speed Ahead
videos.overview: After a white-knuckle driving challenge, tensions rise between families. Some in-laws consider pressing the button — but only one follows through.

videos.title: Heart Divided
videos.overview: A family decides their future on the show. In a session with Shenia, mothers-in-law share their experiences and find a safe space for vulnerability.

videos.title: Tough Nut to Crack
videos.overview: In-laws in the bunker have a chance to connect with their families. A fierce coconut-themed game determines the leaders on the scoreboard.

videos.title: Sins of the Past
videos.overview: Amid heated conflicts and growing tensions inside and outside the bunker, Shenia encourages the in-laws to reflect on themselves using a mirror.

videos.title: To the Rescue!
videos.overview: When two families qualify for the grand finale, the remaining teams compete for a spot in a challenge, testing their communication skills and endurance.

videos.title: The Ties that Bind
videos.overview: All finalists gather to celebrate their journey on the show. Before the grand finale, the families reflect on their growth and ponder life if they win.
